title: fix(cloudflare): split address lists and send display names as objects

files.patch:
@@ -8,11 +8,11 @@ def self.config_options = %w[account_id]
 
         def body
           {
-            "from" => @options.from,
-            "to" => @options.to,
-            "reply_to" => @options.reply_to,
-            "cc" => @options.cc,
-            "bcc" => @options.bcc,
+            "from" => recipients(@options.from)&.first,
+            "to" => recipients(@options.to),
+            "reply_to" => recipients(@options.reply_to)&.first,
+            "cc" => bare_addresses(@options.cc),
+            "bcc" => bare_addresses(@options.bcc),
             "subject" => @options.subject,
             "text" => @options.text,
             "html" => @options.html
@@ -21,6 +21,13 @@ def body
 
         private
 
+        # The API documents cc/bcc as plain address strings (named objects only for from/to)
+        def bare_addresses(value) = recipients(value)&.map { |recipient| recipient["address"] }
+
+        def recipients(value)
+          address_list(value, as: :plain)&.map { |address| email_and_name(address, email_key: "address") }
+        end
+
         def endpoint_url
           account_id = @provider_options.account_id
           raise Courrier::ArgumentError, "Cloudflare requires an `account_id`" unless account_id

Test HTML Body

" + }, + @provider.body + ) + end + + def test_sends_a_display_name_on_reply_to + email = TestEmail.new( + from: "devs@railsdesigner.com", + to: "first@example.com", + reply_to: "Support " + ) + + body = Cloudflare.new(api_key: "test_key", options: email.options, provider_options: Struct.new(:account_id).new("acct")).body + + assert_equal({"address" => "support@railsdesigner.com", "name" => "Support"}, body["reply_to"]) + end + + def test_authenticates_with_api_key + assert_equal({"Authorization" => "Bearer test_key"}, @provider.send(:default_headers)) + end + end +end
